recommendation.title: 35–45 minutes easy
details: Run at conversational effort, RPE 2–3; roughly 5–7 km.
Keep the route flat or gently rolling. No tempo, intervals, hills, strides or fast finish.
Finish early if effort or heart rate rises unusually for the conditions.
recommendation.alternative: 20–30 minutes of easy walking or full rest.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Reduce or stop for pain that changes gait, dizziness, unusual fatigue, illness, chest symptoms or other concerning symptoms.
